_comment: Item sets that only one class can obtain, two groups with different evidence. Naxxramas Tier 3 (setIds 521 and 523-530): Wowhead tags the set with one class, the 'Class:' line on the set's tooltip (source: https://nether.wowhead.com/tbc/tooltip/item-set/<setId>); the pieces' own tooltips have no class line (e.g. https://nether.wowhead.com/tbc/tooltip/item/22436), and in vendor/wowsims/db.json each set's ring carries a classAllowlist, which scripts/check_class_restricted_sets.py holds each classId to. Dungeon Set 2 (setIds 511-519): Wowhead's TBC set tooltip names an armor type and no class, and db.json gives no piece a classAllowlist, so the class comes from Wowhead's appearance-set page for the set (its Quick Facts 'Classes:' line; source: https://www.wowhead.com/classic/transmog-set=<id>), and the rule that another class cannot obtain these pieces rests on the owner's confirmation (the 'confirmed' field; ticket 579). Hand-written. assemble_universe.py drops a piece of one of these sets from every other class's universe, and scripts/check_class_restricted_sets.py fails pnpm verify if one is left in. classId is the common.proto Class enum, which matches Wowhead's class ids. Tier 3 decided at stage-gate cleanup-upstream-footprint, decision-log 2026-10-08T23:36Z, ticket 576; Dungeon Set 2 added 2026-10-09, ticket 579.
